purpose: Source-disjoint development challenge plus explicit output-contract control; candidate operation diagnostic, not learned method confirmation
hypothesis: Focused action should improve source-report concordance beyond generic reporting and a report with explicit target output contract if it has more than formatting value
selection: Exclude180 known source groups from v9 members/inputs and v4 panel, including all96 reserved confirmation groups; among remaining original source metadata, take first3 explicitly normal CXR figures and first3 explicit airspace/consolidation CXR figures by numeric source-case order; one view per group; all6 passed pixel/metadata review; no model outcomes used
reference: Original upstream Eurorad figure captions; report-derived proxy, not new specialist adjudication; not sent to tool

arms.focused: Does this chest X-ray show airspace opacity or consolidation? Answer yes or no.
arms.report_with_decision: Describe the chest X-ray findings. Then finish with exactly one of these statements: Airspace opacity or consolidation: yes. Airspace opacity or consolidation: no. Airspace opacity or consolidation: uncertain.

score: Frozen first-study parser for describe/focused; report_with_decision requires exactly one final explicit target statement; unknown counts incorrect; full denominator
candidate_gate: complete18; focused versus report_with_decision gains>=2, losses=0; focused correctly rejects all3 explicit-normal source references; otherwise no experience promotion
interpretation: First study gains were all unknown-to-explicit outputs concentrated in one source; do not label them corrected clinical mistakes. This control diagnoses that confound.
retry_policy: No prompt adjustment or additional calls within this panel; retain failures
privacy: Metadata stripped, locally reviewed private images; public aggregate only
